set.body: Studio blocker; overlaps CR2's pure result-table layer. Join typed trial covariates (trials.csv: retrieval response, recognition confidence); group, filter (e.g. >25% of duration outside window), participant means with equal weight, per-group n and paired n, 'no value' distinct from 0. CSV, methods text and figures cite this one implementation; reuses pair scores without rerunning. Serializable with a codec bound to plan and run revisions.
set.title: UI-C: ReportSpec, a pure reduction over StudyResult with typed trial covariates
